originalCounterpart: telegram_iphone.src/TelegraphKit/TelegraphKit/TGDialogListController.mm (search paths), TGDialogListSearchCell.m, TGDialogListCell.m (message-scope rows), TGSearchBar.m, TGSearchDisplayMixin.m

findings.ours: src/TGSearchViewController.m:640-646 paints the scope bar with SearchBarBackground.png (a 4x44pt search-bar texture) squashed into a 36pt-tall view.
findings.theirs: The scope bar has its own artwork, SearchBarScopeBarBackground.png, set via setScopeBarBackgroundImage:; SearchBarBackground.png is only the search field's bar.
findings.fix: Copy SearchBarScopeBarBackground@2x.png from the original Resources into images/, and use it (not SearchBarBackground.png) as the scope bar background in buildScopeBar.

findings.ours: kSearchScopeHeight = 36 (src/TGSearchViewController.m:23), buttons laid out at y=3, height 30 (line 808).
findings.theirs: Showing the scope control grows the search bar from 44 to 88, i.e. the scope strip is 44pt tall; the 30pt buttons (SearchBarScopeButton@2x is 74x60 = 37x30pt) sit centred, y=7.
findings.fix: Set kSearchScopeHeight to 44 and position the scope buttons at y=7 with height 30 in layoutScopeBar (and the chat/sender scope buttons likewise).

findings.ours: Scope buttons are drawn edge to edge with no divider art (src/TGSearchViewController.m:733-762, 804-809).
findings.theirs: The scope segments carry divider images between adjacent segments, differing by which side is selected.
findings.fix: Copy SearchScopeBarScopeDividerLeft@2x.png and SearchScopeBarScopeDividerRight@2x.png into images/ and draw a 1pt divider image between adjacent scope buttons, choosing left/right variant by which neighbour is selected.

findings.ours: setTitleText:matching: bolds only the half of the name that matches the query and leaves an unmatched single-word name at systemFontOfSize:19 (src/TGSearchViewController.m:97-136).
findings.theirs: A result with no second name part is drawn entirely in titleLabelSecond, which is boldSystemFontOfSize:19; a first+last name is regular 19 for the first part and bold 19 for the last part, regardless of which one matched.
findings.citation: TGDialogListSearchCell.m:63,71,118-131 (resetView) and TGDialogListController.mm:1331-1348 (no setBoldMode call on this path)
findings.fix: Drop the query-match test: render single-part titles in boldSystemFontOfSize:19, and for two-part names render part one regular 19 and part two bold 19.

findings.ours: Every result title is split at its first space into two labels with a 5pt gap, including conversation/group titles (src/TGSearchViewController.m:107-135).
findings.theirs: Only user results are split, and only on firstName/lastName; conversations set titleTextSecond = nil so the whole title is one uninterrupted label.
findings.fix: Only split when the row is a contact/user and carry the first and last name separately from the row dictionary; for chat/channel rows put the whole title in one label.

findings.ours: Chat hits carry the last message text and contacts carry "@username" as a subtitle, making the 51pt row two-line (src/TGSearchViewController.m:1342-1346, 1373-1378).
findings.theirs: Search rows never show a subtitle: cell.subtitleText = nil for both the conversation and the user branch, so the 19pt title is vertically centred in the 51pt row.
findings.fix: Leave subtitle empty for chat and contact hits so the row falls into the single-line centred branch; keep subtitles only for the newer global-search/link rows that have no 2013 counterpart.

findings.ours: Results are split into headed sections "Conversations" / "Contacts" (src/TGSearchViewController.m:1750-1753).
findings.theirs: Scope-0 results are one flat, header-free list mixing conversations and users in the order the search actor returned them.
findings.citation: TGDialogListController.mm:1106-1116 (numberOfRows returns _searchResults.count, single section) and 1299 (one cell class for conversation or user); no titleForHeaderInSection on the search table
findings.fix: Merge chatHits and contactHits into one unheaded section for the plain query case; keep headers only for the sections that have no 2013 equivalent (Global Search, Hashtags, Messages).

findings.theirs: titleLabelWidth = dateFrame.origin.x - 4 - 73 - 18, i.e. width - dateWidth - 104, so the title truncates 15pt earlier and never crowds the date.
findings.fix: Compute titleWidth as (viewSize.width - dateWidth - 9) - 4 - kSearchMessageTextLeft - 18 in TGSearchMessageCell layoutSubviews.

findings.ours: Message-row date frame is (width - 9 - dateWidth, 8, dateWidth, 16) with dateWidth padded by +4 (src/TGSearchViewController.m:272-279).
findings.theirs: dateFrame = CGRectMake(size.width - dateWidth - 9, 9, 75, 15) with dateWidth the exact measured text width, no padding.
findings.fix: Drop the +4 padding, set y = 9 and height = 15 for _dateLabel in TGSearchMessageCell.

findings.ours: For group results the sender is folded into the grey message text as "Sender: text" in systemFontOfSize:14 / 0x888888 (src/TGSearchViewController.m:1416-1417, 230-235).
findings.theirs: The author name is a separate run drawn in boldSystemFontOfSize:14 in 0x345f8f above/before the message text.
findings.fix: Draw the sender prefix as a separate bold 14 label in #345F8F at x=73,y=29 and offset the message text after it, instead of concatenating into the grey string.

findings.ours: docs/design-language/components.md:160 states the 51pt search variant uses DialogListSearchCell.png / …Highlighted.
findings.theirs: TGDialogListSearchCell loads Cell102.png and CellHighlighted102.png for its background and selected background; DialogListSearchCell.png exists in Resources but is not used by this cell.
findings.fix: Correct components.md:160 to name Cell102.png / CellHighlighted102.png for the search cell (our code at TGSearchViewController.m:41-46 is already right); other agents reading the rulebook would otherwise swap in the wrong plate.
